description: Named variables of the Twinfeeler's behaviour (chara/Twinfeeler/behavior.lua reads and writes them by name). Each character instance owns a small block of bytes; every entry of "fields" names one value in it: "name" is the name the script uses, "kind" the storage type (s8, u8, s16, u16, s32, u32: a write keeps the low bits, a read sign- or zero-extends), "at" the byte offset in the block (absent: the next naturally aligned offset), "note" what the value means. Values are raw integers in the units the behaviour uses (usually Q12, 4096 = 1.0 or 1 m; angles Q12, 4096 = a full turn). A mod adds or changes fields with a state.json of the same path; keep the offsets of fields the behaviour already uses.

fields.name: twinfeeler_vocal_timer
fields.note: Before the fight: the time to the next growl.

fields.name: twinfeeler_ground_bits
fields.note: One bit per body bone: the bone was below the floor on the last tick (a change raises dust).

fields.name: twinfeeler_push_x
fields.note: The push of the last hit (it slides the body, then decays).

fields.name: twinfeeler_walk_speed
fields.note: move_speed of the control state, kept while the push is added for the step.

fields.name: twinfeeler_stun
fields.note: The death starts with the stun clip (1) or stands up first (0).

fields.name: twinfeeler_saved_health
fields.note: Health while underground (health itself is -1 there: nothing can hit it).
